semiconductor_relevance: High — Panther Technology specializes in magnetic levitation technology applications specifically for semiconductor precision equipment.
summary: Panther Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. focuses on the industrial application of magnetic levitation technology, providing solutions for ultra-clean, energy-efficient, and precision-control scenarios in the semiconductor sector. Their offerings include maglev bearingless pumps and core components tailored for semiconductor manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.China: Panther operates its headquarters in Shenzhen and has an R&D and production base in Hefei.
